snippet.title: Untarctica - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Something is rotten at the South Pole. Blast through disfigured abominations using your gun's massive recoil in a fast-paced 1-bit bullet-hell platformer. Infiltrate the abandoned Magnus Coriolis station, dodge lethal crossfire, and uncover top-secret horrors hidden beneath the ice in Untarctica!

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4163950/Untarctica/

#Untarctica #IndieGame #BulletHell #Platformer #SciFiHorror
